notes.title: English ver Update! and new game public steam store page!
notes.content: [p]After attending the Guangzhou Indie Game Only event, we have implemented several optimizations to our game based on the feedback received.[/p][p]If you like our work, please add wishlist![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745440/_/?curator_clanid=45674723"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And now, an important announcement—[/p][p]Our award-winning RPG Maker creation, *Apollo Sonata*, will be released in a full version on Steam! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965670/__Apollo_Sonata/?snr=1_7_7_151_150_1"][/dynamiclink]Please add it to your wishlist[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Major Updates[/b][/p][p]Added English localization—special thanks to Huiyu for proofreading assistance.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Other Improvements[/b][/p][p]*Added Auto-advance and Skip options for more convenient dialogue progression.[/p][p]* Enhanced the save system—now you can save your game anytime, anywhere![/p][p]* Improved controls—press Space or Enter to advance dialogue.[/p][p]* Refined puzzle mechanics—use the Q key or click buttons to activate abilities[/p][p]* Optimized Level Selection UI for clearer progress tracking.[/p][p]*Fixed several bugs[/p][p]*Further improved interactive guidance for more intuitive gameplay.[/p][p]* Enhanced puzzle hint UI.[/p]

notes.title: Major Update! MikkwaySubway DEMO Now Released!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813404/b7f9bf9bb16d7041c5062d908816e89068e1b9a6.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]First and foremost, thank you all for your long patience!!!! <3[/p][p][/p][p]Since our last demo release, we've received extensive feedback from players and have implemented comprehensive optimizations based on your suggestions. ><[/p][p][/p][p]This update represents countless hours of our developers' dedication. [b]It covers narrative text, sound effects, tutorials, UI interactions, user experience, and BUG fixes[/b] – all aimed at delivering a significantly improved player experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]We invite everyone to try the DEMO, leave a Steam review, and wishlist the game![/p][p] [/p][p]To report BUGs or join closed testing, please join our player QQ group: 8662058063[/p][p] [b]DEMO:[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953010/Demo/"][/dynamiclink]  [b]Full Version (Available for wishlisting!!):[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745440/_/"][/dynamiclink]

[b]Below are the detailed update notes:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Major optimization of narrative text/story pacing for deeper immersion and smoother progression[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced numerous sound effects with original creations[/p][/*][*][p]Added several voice acting segments[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new CGs and replaced select art assets[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized UI and tutorials; added quest log functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Added fullscreen option for enhanced immersion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various BUGs (including font library issues)[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]Happy gaming![/i][/b][/p]
